csv_project_name: Sacramento Airports ON-CALL Architectural & Engrg Svc
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Sacramento (County) owns and/or operates four airports in Sacramento County, including Sacramento International Airport (SMF or Airport), through the Department of Airports (SCDA or Department). The Department is issuing this Request for Proposals (RFP) to solicit proposals from prospective service providers (Consultants) to provide on-call architectural, engineering and/or cost estimating services. The Department intends to establish multiple on-call professional services contracts through this RFP process. Selected consultants will enter into master agreements with the County for a defined term and not-to-exceed maximum compensation amounts. The award of an agreement shall not be taken as guaranteeing a minimum level of services. Services will be authorized through written task orders issued by the Department on an as-needed basis. Each task order will define the specific scope, deliverables, schedule, and compensation for the assigned project. II. PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES The County seeks to establish long-term, on-call relationships with highly qualified consultants capable of delivering responsive, high-quality services in support of Airport facilities and infrastructure. Selection will be based on demonstrated competence, experience, and professional qualifications. The County is seeking proposals from architectural, engineering and cost consulting consultants which can provide services in the following disciplines on an as-needed basis: Architectural Civil Request for Qualifications Page 3 of 14 Architectural and Engineering On-Call Consulting Services Structural Mechanical/Plumbing Electrical Costing/Estimating On-call services may support a wide range of Airport-owned and operated facilities. Projects may include feasibility studies, facility assessments, programming, tenant improvements, paving, renovations, new construction, deferred maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, code compliance improvements, and emergency response work.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Cost Estimating, Feasibility Studies, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Sacramento Airports On-Call Architectural and Engineering Services
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary design services for Sacramento County airport facilities and infrastructure projects.
project_scope: On-call professional services for four Sacramento County airports, including Sacramento International Airport. Potential task orders may cover feasibility studies, facility assessments, programming, tenant improvements, paving, renovations, new construction, deferred maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, code compliance improvements, and emergency response work for airport-owned and operated facilities.
services: On-call architectural, engineering, and cost estimating services through multiple master agreements. Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, cost estimating, feasibility studies, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering/plumbing, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call contract with multiple disciplines and no defined individual structure.
- Primarily general airport facility and infrastructure support, not a specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Includes structural engineering, which is marginally relevant.
- Also includes many services outside sbp's core focus, such as MEP, geotechnical, traffic, and general architectural support.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. This is an on-call master agreement for as-needed task orders across multiple airport projects, so no realistic overall construction cost can be derived from the notice.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget for the master agreements or individual task orders is stated in the notice. Compensation is to be defined per task order under not-to-exceed master agreements.
references_qualifications: Selection is based on demonstrated competence, experience, and professional qualifications of consultants capable of providing responsive, high-quality on-call services for airport facilities and infrastructure. No specific minimum reference counts are stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Selection will be based on demonstrated competence, experience, and professional qualifications. No weighting is stated in the provided text.

notes: Project No. 2026-WW-02. Multiple on-call professional services contracts are intended. Base period 36 months with 24-month renewal option; renewable. Questions deadline: 06/09/2026 12:00 PM PDT. The award of an agreement does not guarantee a minimum level of services.
